### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **215** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **155** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **155**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **100** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **136** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c118524061a902880c6dbf9cb68c2df97c1a7694` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `a5e5b18afd9847f2bf935c6bd3332b536c2d4d83` — the merge of head `99c17b3cbbaef2300e2a07edf18228083953e059` into base `c118524061a902880c6dbf9cb68c2df97c1a7694`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin a5e5b18afd9847f2bf935c6bd3332b536c2d4d83 && git checkout a5e5b18afd9847f2bf935c6bd3332b536c2d4d83
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c118524061a902880c6dbf9cb68c2df97c1a7694 99c17b3cbbaef2300e2a07edf18228083953e059 && git checkout -B drift-repro c118524061a902880c6dbf9cb68c2df97c1a7694 && git merge --no-ff 99c17b3cbbaef2300e2a07edf18228083953e059

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c118524061a902880c6dbf9cb68c2df97c1a7694
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `99c17b3cbbaef2300e2a07edf18228083953e059`

<sub>Reviewed and posted 2026-09-23T09:34Z by the at-tier review subagent the `domain:spec#5` seat spawned — read: card #19748 with comments `5786904246` / `5791387826` / `5792033246`, the PR body, both commits, the diff against merge-base `6eaa0f4a81`, the head's 39 check-runs, AGENTS.md, contract-review.md, the two schema files, `lazy-schema.ts`, the spec `package.json`, the workflow `if:` lines, the trailer gate; ran: an own TypeScript-AST runtime import graph over `packages/spec/src` (1524 files, 2114 runtime edges, 691 `import type` statements dropped, 0 unresolved relative specifiers) with lit and dark controls, an eager-mode cycle injection in a private worktree (restored, 0 modified paths), a model-identifier sweep with lit and dark controls, a check-run de-dup; NOT MEASURED: the "0 / 8 built files" claim (needs a spec build) and the developer's local gate numbers (derived gate family, not re-run by rule — CI at head is the evidence).</sub>

### ① Derived judgments

- **The new sentence is true.** `InstalledPackageSchema` is declared at `kernel/package-registry.zod.ts:55`. `api/package-api.zod.ts:5` is a bare value import of it (no `type`), used as a value at `:120` (`AssembledInstalledPackageSchema`), `:167` (`InstalledPackageAtEitherStageSchema`) and `:548` (`PackageInstallResponseSchema`), so the edge survives erasure. Own graph: direct runtime edge `api/package-api.zod.ts → kernel/package-registry.zod.ts` YES; existing path `package-registry → package-api` NO PATH (no cycle today; registry's only src runtime imports are `manifest.zod`, `dependency-resolution.zod`, `shared/lazy-schema`); with the hypothetical up-reference added, the 2-cycle `package-api → package-registry → package-api` closes. `PackageInstallRequestSchema` sits above (it is the importer) — true.
- **The card's own suggested repair would have been false, as the developer says.** `PackageInstallRequestSchema` (`api/package-api.zod.ts:352-461`) reads `ManifestSchema` (`:354`) and `ArtifactReferenceSchema` (`:459`); no `InstalledPackageSchema` occurs in that span. And `ManifestSchema` plays no part in the cycle: its runtime closure is 32 files (self excluded; the PR says 33 — one-off reading difference, not material), max depth 4, containing neither file. None of `package-api`'s other nine src runtime imports reaches `package-registry`.
- **Instrument controls.** Lit: `stack.zod → kernel/manifest.zod`, `kernel/manifest.zod → ui/app.zod`, `package-api → manifest.zod` all found. Dark: a zero-import leaf → `package-registry` NO PATH; a nonexistent target NO PATH.
- **The rest of the block still reads true.** "declared here" now attaches to `InstalledPackageSchema` alone — true. The directive (`⛔ Do not "fix" this into PackageInstallRequestSchema.shape.enableOnInstall`) is byte-unchanged (diff = 1 source line). The `OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS` sentence: `shared/lazy-schema.ts:22` evaluates the factory eagerly when `OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS === '1'`; `gen:schema` = `OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS=1 tsx scripts/build-schemas.ts`, `check:authorable-surface` = the same with `--check`, and `build-schemas.ts:6` sets it too. Ran, in my worktree, with the forbidden `import { PackageInstallRequestSchema } from '../api/package-api.zod'` + `PackageInstallRequestSchema.shape.enableOnInstall` injected: baseline (unmodified) loads under eager; eager + cycle, registry loads first → `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'InstalledPackageSchema' before initialization` (the text the block names); package-api loads first → the mirror `…'PackageInstallRequestSchema'…`; eager unset → both entries load (the proxy absorbs it). "Measured in both directions" holds. The block's earlier half (`:285-293`) still names the authority in `src/api/package-api.zod.ts` and the pin `src/api/package-install-one-authority.test.ts` (exists, 26 `enableOnInstall` mentions), so "the pin above" still resolves. No other line in the file claims `ManifestSchema` is declared there (`:4` is the import; `:52-86`, `:234`, `:278` are uses).
- **Changeset text: every claim true.** The doc comment is on `InstallPackageRequestSchema` (`:276`), key `enableOnInstall`; `ManifestSchema` declared at `kernel/manifest.zod.ts:317`; `api/package-api.zod.ts` declares `PackageInstallRequestSchema` (`:352`) and imports `InstalledPackageSchema` (`:5`); "doc comment only" — yes. The `(#19748)` citation is the house form (368 changesets at head carry one).
- **PR body: nothing false found.** "ten direct runtime imports" matches (10 src imports incl. `shared/lazy-schema` at `:41`; `zod` besides). Its three uses of `InstalledPackageSchema` match `:120/:167/:548`. Its local verification numbers and the "0 / 8 built files" count are NOT MEASURED here (see the sub line); CI at head stands in.
- **Public surface / accepted set: unchanged.** No key, export or `.describe()` moves; `src/**/*.zod.ts` is in the spec `files[]`, so the corrected bytes do ship (which is why a changeset is owed).
- **CI at head**, 39 runs → 35 names by latest `started_at`: 30 success, 5 skipped, 0 failure, 0 in progress. Required seven (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Build Core`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`) all success. Skips, each from its `if:`: `Build Docs` — ci.yml:2167, the `docs` filter (`apps/docs/**`, `content/**`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `ci.yml`) matches neither changed path; `Console Pin Gate` — ci.yml:2337, the `console` filter (`.objectui-sha`, console scripts, `ci.yml`) matches neither; `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)` — needs the `needs:pack-smoke` label, PR labels are `documentation`, `size/xs`, `tooling`, `needs:contract-review`; `Auto Label` and `Check PR Size` — their later run is skipped by `action != labeled/unlabeled/edited` (pr-automation.yml:141, :211) and their `opened` runs were success; the later run coincides with the PR's label change (exact action not in the check-run payload — inferred).
- **Model identifiers:** swept both commit messages, the diff, the PR title and body for every model-identifier spelling — clean; lit control hit 3/3 lines, dark control (product-name footer and trailer forms) clean. The fix commit carries the model-free trailer pair; the merge commit carries none, which the trailer gate treats as clean (`check-commit-card-trailers.mjs:130`, self-test `:892`).

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/spec: patch` with `Clause-②: no` — correct. Comment bytes in a shipped file, no accepted-set or export change, so `no`; a fix in a released package takes `patch`, never none (AGENTS.md Post-Task §3). `Check Changeset` success on both its runs.

Non-blocking:
- `Fixes #19748` — right: the card's scope is the source doc block only and the PR corrects it wholly; the claim `5791387826` names this branch; `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` and `Part-of PR must not also close its card` are both success.
- main merged once (`6eaa0f4a81`) — allowed; CI ran on the merge head; merge-base equals it, so the PR-own diff is exactly the 2 files; `mergeable_state: clean`.
- Out-of-scope note on `.changeset/18605-enable-on-install-one-authority.md:19` — read at head: it says the authority "is built from `ManifestSchema` and `InstalledPackageSchema`, both declared in `kernel/package-registry.zod.ts`"; both halves false by the readings in ①; triage `5786904246` assigned that fragment to #19735; noted-not-filed with a named carrier is the right disposition, and the two carriers will disagree until #19735 lands — the card itself anticipates that.
- PR is still `draft: true` — a landing-state note for the seat, not a review defect.
- `open_questions` is empty; nothing to answer.
